//TR: Kalıcı üretim kuyruğu ve kontrol noktası: merge hattı askıdayken korumasız dosyalarda gerçek kod üreten Builder görevlerini, durumlarını ve dal/PR bilgisini saklar. Yetki kaydı DEĞİLDİR; hiçbir korunan dosya, yeni endpoint, POST, IPC veya depolama yetkisi vermez.
purpose: Persistent production queue and checkpoint for builder work while the merge lane is suspended. It is NOT an authority record. It grants no protected-file, endpoint, POST, IPC, storage, mobile, or merge authority.
basis: Founder chat directives of 2026-10-21 (SECURE RECOVERY Stage 7; CONTINUOUS REAL PRODUCTION sections 2-6), as reported by the coordinator. The coordinator's account is not an authority record. Work is limited to unprotected files under the existing builder rules of D-2026-10-19-A, with no new endpoints, allow-list entries, POST, IPC or storage, no protected paths and no security-critical runtime files.
mergeLane: SUSPENDED (Founder): finished work stays on its branch with a DRAFT PR until the secure merge process (independent reviewer identity, GitHub-enforced approval, required checks) exists.
statusNotes: DESIGN_ONLY, CODE_IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, INTEGRATED and PRODUCT_ACCEPTED are separate states. A finished builder task is at most TESTED: unit/renderer tests ran, Linux only, Windows NOT_EXECUTED. INTEGRATED needs a merge. PRODUCT_ACCEPTED needs real operational evidence.
claimRule: Before any work, create the branch claude/<id lowercased> as a create-only ref (git push origin <base sha>:refs/heads/claude/<id>; if the ref already exists, the task is owned, so skip it). Never force-push. Never delete a claude/* branch.
capacityRule: LIVE = claude/* claim branches whose head is younger than 6 h and that have no open PR. If LIVE >= builderCap, start nothing.

tasks.title: Renderer product-verification honesty: show PRODUCT_VERIFIED only on the server's exact rule
acceptance: Read core/workos/outcomes.ts productVerificationOf (around :93-110) and mirror it exactly in work-core.js. PRODUCT_VERIFIED needs both VERIFY_TESTS and REGRESSION_TESTS evidence for the run's head SHA, exit 0, sandbox attestation and an executed test count above 0. A non-zero exit gives FAILED; missing, non-head or partial evidence gives NOT_VERIFIED.

delivery.js and m1a.js use only that function. views/work.js belongs to UI-105 until that merges: fix its badge through the shared work-core helper, and if work.js itself must change, STOP and report.

Update tests/v7-ux-delivery.test.ts:74-85 to expect the stricter behaviour, and add negative cases for a failing exit, a non-head SHA, one suite only, a zero executed count and no attestation. No other assertion may be weakened.
GET-only: no new endpoint, POST, IPC or storage.

tasks.title: Asserting test for the Tower scheduler fact (UI-206)
acceptance: Render the Tower view with stub ctx data and assert the scheduler fact for the VERIFIED, UNAVAILABLE, ERROR and missing-data cases (honest '—' or pill, never a fabricated number).
Mutation check: removing the scheduler fact from the view must make the new test fail; record the command and the output.
Test-only change: no renderer source edits.

tasks.title: Evidence lineage as a navigable graph view in #/assurance (read-only)
tasks.base: claude/ui-105 head once its draft PR is open (stacked; assurance.js overlap)
acceptance: Build the mission → run → evidence lineage from the existing GET data as a keyboard-navigable node/edge view, with an accessible list fallback. No new reads.
Honest states for missing links; never infer a link that is not in the data.
Unique data-* names, token-only CSS, h()/textContent only.

tasks.title: Theme contrast lab in #/settings: WCAG contrast preview built from the existing tokens
tasks.base: claude/ui-105 head once its draft PR is open (stacked; settings.js overlap)
acceptance: List the token pairs with their computed contrast ratio and AA/AAA result. The ratios are computed from the token values in the stylesheet, never typed in by hand.
No storage, no POST, no new endpoint; read-only.

tasks.title: Provider & model routing view (read-only) from the existing executors/capabilities/adapters GETs
acceptance: Show which executor, provider and capability would route a task, using only values returned by existing allow-listed GETs. Registry values are carried verbatim, never promoted to active/connected.
No new POST: the existing local-claude enable action stays where it is.

tasks.title: Make the two host-sensitive tests robust without weakening them
acceptance: Replace the substring home-path leak check with a precise absolute-path check that still fails on any real leak. Prove this with a deliberate leak (mutation) that must fail.
Make the unix-socket test independent of a long TMPDIR by using a short dedicated temp root. Never skip it and never raise timeouts.
Both files pass with HOME=/root and with a long TMPDIR. The pass/fail count before and after is recorded.
